properties.summary: ReliefWeb posted 10 reports in the last 7 days, against an average of 2.42 per week over the 12 weeks before, with Djibouti as the main country of the report. Unusual (RL-IND-4): at that average, the chance of 10 or more in a week is under 0.1%, below the 1% threshold. A count of reports measures reporting attention, not need.
